blockers.title: A successful note save still discards newer text typed into that same student's enabled editor
blockers.evidence: src/features/evaluations/EvaluationManagement.tsx:107-119 leaves the textarea editable while saving; :523-528 closes the current editor when its student ID matches the completed save, without checking whether its draft changed after submission. Independent scratch review.test.tsx:710 fails because the expected Bea textbox has been unmounted. The immediately preceding assertion confirms saveEvaluation received only the earlier captured text for course-1/student-2/sat-pm.
blockers.reproduction: On 3598ce5, defer Bea's save, open her evaluation note and type 'Testo inviato'. Tap Salva nota. While Salvataggio… is shown, the same enabled textbox accepts ' più nuovo testo', and an assertion confirms its value is 'Testo inviato più nuovo testo'. Resolve the first successful save. Observed: the editor disappears, the saved record/preview contains only 'Testo inviato', and the additional text has no save or explicit discard. Expected: preserve the newer typed draft and keep it available for its own save or explicit cancellation; completion may close an editor only when the current draft still corresponds to that completed submission. Scratch command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config <scratch>/vitest.workspace.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 -t review:. Result: 1 failed, 1 passed, 14 original tests skipped. Source/config/log are preserved in OS temporary cvc-d4-di-r4-note-QnOISR; the pointer is cvc-d4-di-r4-note-location.txt.
